description: The VALUES spelling of a report group description entry's VALUE clause (kb/Work PB5242). §1985:XIII.3.22.2 prints `VALUE IS literal-1` for "Report Section printable items" (§1985:XIII.3.22.1); ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.61.1 Format 4 prints `{VALUE IS | VALUES ARE} {literal-1}...`, its SR7 "The words VALUE and VALUES are equivalent". The more-than-one-literal form needs a repeating entry (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR35, COBOL2012), every one of which is already a 2002 form, so it is not this row's. Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitValueClause inside a report group description entry, once per written clause (VCR row 7.45 (f)).
display: the VALUES spelling of the VALUE clause (report group description)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (f) - VALUES ARE in a report entry (85->2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRVS.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRVS.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC 9(3) VALUE 5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 PAGE LIMIT IS 20 LINES.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(3) VALUES ARE "ABC".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
